name: Yonex
knownFor: Largest global badminton brand. Astrox, Nanoflare, Voltric, Arcsaber lines plus Aerosensa shuttles and SHB shoes. Sponsors many top BWF players.
knownForZh: 全球最大羽毛球品牌。代表系列包括 Astrox、Nanoflare、Voltric、Arcsaber，以及 Aerosensa 球与 SHB 系列球鞋。多名 BWF 顶尖球员代言。

name: Victor
knownFor: Premier Taiwanese brand. Auraspeed, Thruster, Brave Sword, Jetspeed, DriveX racket lines plus Champion shuttles. Sponsor of Korean and Chinese-Taipei national teams.
knownForZh: 台湾顶尖品牌。Auraspeed、Thruster、Brave Sword、Jetspeed、DriveX 球拍系列与 Champion 球。韩国与中华台北国家队赞助。

name: Li-Ning
knownFor: Chinese flagship; sponsors PRC national team. Axforce, Bladex, Halbertec, Aeronaut, Tectonic racket lines plus A+ shuttles.
knownForZh: 中国旗舰品牌，国家队赞助。Axforce、Bladex、Halbertec、Aeronaut、Tectonic 球拍系列与 A+ 球。

name: Kumpoo
knownFor: Strong value-for-money brand widely used by Chinese club players. Power Cloud, K600, K529, K520 series. Often discussed on badmintoncn.com.
knownForZh: 性价比突出，中羽社区常见品牌。Power Cloud 系列、K600、K529、K520 等型号。

name: Kawasaki
knownFor: Entry to mid-tier Japanese-origin brand widely sold in China. King series, Honor, Spider rackets. Common starter brand for new players.
knownForZh: 中国市场常见的中端品牌。King、Honor、Spider 系列。新手起步常见品牌。

name: Mizuno
knownFor: Strong on shoes and apparel; smaller racket presence. Wave Claw shoe line is popular for stability and wider fit.
knownForZh: 球鞋与服装强势；球拍线偏小。Wave Claw 系列球鞋以稳定与宽楦著称。

name: Kason
knownFor: Chinese brand later acquired by Li-Ning. Heritage in entry-to-mid rackets; strong availability inside China.
knownForZh: 已并入李宁的中国老牌。中低端球拍口碑稳定，中国大陆铺货广泛。

name: Apacs
knownFor: Malaysian brand with strong following in SE Asia. Feather Weight, Z-Series, Edgesaber rackets are popular value picks.
knownForZh: 东南亚口碑较好的马来西亚品牌。Feather Weight、Z 系列、Edgesaber 性价比突出。

name: FZ Forza
knownFor: European mainstay, especially in Denmark and the UK. Power, Aero, Light racket lines plus shoes and apparel.
knownForZh: 欧洲主流品牌，丹麦与英国市场尤为常见。Power、Aero、Light 系列球拍以及球鞋服装。

name: RSL
knownFor: Long-running shuttle and racket brand. Tournament shuttles widely used in club leagues; rackets also available.
knownForZh: 老牌球与球拍厂商。锦标级球在俱乐部联赛使用广泛，球拍线齐全。

name: Hundred
knownFor: Fast-growing Indian brand. Powertek, Cosmic, Atomic racket lines plus shoes — strong India / SE Asia presence.
knownForZh: 印度增长迅速的新品牌。Powertek、Cosmic、Atomic 系列球拍及球鞋，印度与东南亚市占增长快。

name: Babolat
knownFor: Heritage tennis brand with a smaller but premium badminton line. Satelite Power, X-Feel rackets.
knownForZh: 法国百年品牌，羽毛球线虽小但定位高端。Satelite Power、X-Feel 系列。

name: Carlton
knownFor: British heritage brand. Vapour, Kinesis, Aerospeed rackets — strong club presence in UK and Commonwealth.
knownForZh: 英国老牌。Vapour、Kinesis、Aerospeed 系列在英国与英联邦国家俱乐部市场常见。

name: Wilson
knownFor: Tennis-first brand with a smaller badminton line. Recon, Blaze, Fierce racket families.
knownForZh: 网球大牌的羽毛球副线。Recon、Blaze、Fierce 等系列。

name: Ashaway
knownFor: Specialist string maker. ZyMax, Rally 21, Dynamic 10 are popular for blended setups.
knownForZh: 专业球线品牌。ZyMax、Rally 21、Dynamic 10 在混合穿线中常见。

name: Felet
knownFor: Malaysian rackets and shoes — strong in SE Asia club scene. TJ Power, Champion racket lines.
knownForZh: 马来西亚本土球拍与球鞋品牌，东南亚俱乐部市场常见。TJ Power、Champion 系列。

name: Fleet
knownFor: Long-running Malaysian brand; Power Max, Aerogliss, Nano Carbonex racket lines.
knownForZh: 马来西亚老牌。Power Max、Aerogliss、Nano Carbonex 等型号。

name: Yang Yang
knownFor: Chinese brand founded by former player Yang Yang. SSR, Ultra Star racket families.
knownForZh: 由前国手杨阳创立的中国品牌。SSR、Ultra Star 等系列。

name: Karakal
knownFor: British squash-leading brand with a badminton line known for ultra-light frames (sub-65g rackets).
knownForZh: 英国壁球大牌的羽毛球线，以超轻球拍（低于 65 克）见长。

name: Gosen
knownFor: Japanese string specialist popular in Asia. G-TONE 5, G-TONE 9, Roots ARMOR PRO are common.
knownForZh: 日本球线品牌，亚洲市场常见。G-TONE 5、G-TONE 9、Roots ARMOR PRO 等。

name: Bonny
knownFor: Taiwanese badminton brand with a Demon-Slayer-themed ZhanGuiDao attack line, Mythical Beast (WuQue) flagship series, and the Breath self-developed speed-attack family. One of the most credible fourth-brand contenders after the Yonex/Victor/Li-Ning oligopoly.
knownForZh: 台湾羽毛球品牌。斩鬼刀进攻系列、乌缺四神兽旗舰系列与自研呼吸系列均有口碑，是雅尼克斯/胜利/李宁三大厂之外最具竞争力的第四品牌之一。
